title: Privacy policy
body:
## Overview

[Placeholder] Dr Tranter Aesthetics is committed to protecting the privacy of personal and health information collected from patients, in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles and applicable state and territory health records legislation.

[Placeholder] This policy outlines what information we collect, why we collect it, how it is used and stored, and the circumstances under which it may be disclosed to third parties.

## What we collect

[Placeholder] We collect personal information such as your name, contact details and date of birth, as well as sensitive health information including medical history, treatment records, consultation notes and, where relevant, clinical photographs.

[Placeholder] Information is collected directly from you, whether through our website, over the phone, or in person at consultation.

## How we use your information

[Placeholder] Your information is used to provide safe and appropriate clinical care, to communicate with you about appointments and treatment plans, and to meet our legal and professional record-keeping obligations.

[Placeholder] We do not use or disclose your health information for direct marketing without your explicit consent.

## Storage and security

[Placeholder] Patient records are stored securely, whether in physical or electronic form, with access limited to staff directly involved in your care. Reasonable steps are taken to protect information against loss, misuse and unauthorised access.

## Your rights

[Placeholder] You may request access to, or correction of, your personal information at any time by contacting the clinic directly. Requests are handled in accordance with applicable privacy legislation and within a reasonable timeframe.

[Placeholder] If you have concerns about how your information has been handled, you may lodge a complaint with the clinic in the first instance, or with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner.
